findings.claim: The unrelated primitive-writer edit changes the wire encoding of ushort values 128–255: they previously used the one-byte UInt8 payload (0xcc), but now fall through to UInt16 encoding (0xcd), increasing output size and altering bytes produced for existing inputs. This regression is unrelated to the referenced-assembly generic-type crash.

receipt_plan.detail: Using base-built and head-built MessagePackPrimitives, write ushort values 127, 128, 255, and 256 and compare the emitted bytes. The head build encodes 128 and 255 with the UInt16 marker 0xcd instead of the base build's UInt8 marker 0xcc.

findings.claim: Suppressing diagnostics for members of metadata-only types and documenting that their defining assembly reports those diagnostics matches the recorded product decision; it is not an unintended loss of analyzer coverage.

receipt_plan.detail: [L12] Types from referenced assemblies are deliberately not analysed by the consuming compilation; the defining assembly owns validation, so missing member diagnostics there are not defects.
